newsitem.title: UK: UK insurance network LIMNET names Ashby chief executive.
newsitem.headline: UK insurance network LIMNET names Ashby chief executive.

text.p: LIMNET on Thursday named Kevin Ashby as chief executive to succeed Michael Burton, who became deputy chairman on January 1.
Ashby joins LIMNET from accountants KPMG, where he was in charge of internal information technology, LIMNET said in a statement.
London Insurance Market Network (LIMNET) aims to provide a common computer based communications infrastructure for insurers in the London Market which will speed up the transaction of business.
Usage of LIMNET has been slower than planned, but LIMNET chairman Dieter Losse said it had nonetheless put London ahead of other insurance centres.

"London can take some pride in the fact that, although the road has not been as smooth as we might have expected, it has already led to achievements which are unmatched in the world of insurance," Losse said.
Ashby would bring useful experience to LIMNET from other industries, he added.
